title: Classic Dock
description: the dock COLUMN — the tab strip, the resize handle, the panel body. Ships the shipped implementation (DOCK_CLASSIC) from @fraym/ui rather than a reduced lookalike, so a fully marketplace-assembled space is byte-identical to the built-in one. Fills the `dock-column` contract, NOT `dock`: a component declaring `dock` is an instrument (one tab). This is the column those tabs live in.
